title: Dynamics of Stochastic Momentum with Sparse Updates in High Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2605.28961v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing theory of momentum assumes that gradients arrive at every parameter at a roughly constant rate, an assumption violated in practice by heavy-tailed data distributions and modern architectures. We theoretically analyze the dynamics of two tractable models of momentum under sparse updates: a least squares model with sparse inputs and a logistic regression model with a rare class. Both admit exact closed-form second-moment dynamics whose high-dimensional limits we characterize across three scaling exponents for sparsity, batch size, and momentum decay. The phase structure on both problems is governed by the ratio of two intrinsic timescales: a momentum retention timescale (how many active updates the buffer survives) and a learning timescale (how many active updates it takes to reduce the squared error). translated_title: 高维稀疏更新下随机动量的动力学
translated_abstract: 现有的动量理论假设梯度以大致恒定的速率到达每个参数，但这一假设在实践中会因重尾数据分布和现代架构而被打破。我们从理论上分析了稀疏更新下两个可解析求解的动量模型的动力学：一个是具有稀疏输入的最小二乘模型，另一个是具有稀有类别的逻辑回归模型。两者都具有精确的闭式二阶矩动力学，我们在稀疏度、批次大小和动量衰减的三个标度指数下刻画了其高维极限。两个问题的相结构均由两个内在时间尺度之比决定：动量保持时间尺度（缓冲区能存活多少次有效更新）和学习时间尺度（减少平方误差需要多少次有效更新）。当学习远慢于保持时，极限与SGD一致；当学习更快时，系统不稳定；……
tldr: 该论文首次在高维稀疏更新场景下精确刻画了动量优化的二阶矩动力学，揭示了其相变结构由动量保持时间尺度与学习时间尺度之比决定：学习慢于保持时极限等价于SGD，学习快于保持时系统失稳。
en_tdlr: This paper provides exact high-dimensional analysis of stochastic momentum dynamics under sparse updates, revealing a phase structure governed by the ratio of momentum retention to learning timescales: the limit matches SGD when learning is slower than retention, while faster learning leads to instability.
